title: auto-build-loop automation.json (schema_version 2)
description: Contract for specs/<feature>/automation.json consumed by scripts/auto-build-loop.sh. schema_version 1 documents (without the unattended block) remain valid and resolve to pre-#190 behavior. Enforced by scripts/validate-automation-config.sh (jq-based, so hosts need no JSON-Schema tooling); this file is the authoritative contract the script mirrors. Increment A of #190: the three unattended.on_* keys accept ONLY "terminate" — recovery values (adjudicate, swap_builder) do not exist until increment D and must be unrequestable; on_origin_gate is terminate-only in ALL increments (an agent re-checking alignment against a spec it may have misread is circular).

verification.description: #222 (increment C1 of #190) + #242 (increment C2). C1 implements `coverage`; C2 adds `conformance`. test/app/visual are rejected by name by validate-automation-config.sh rather than accepted-and-ignored (an unattended contract must not accept enforcement-looking settings that do nothing). conformance.required is DERIVED from verification.yaml per #190 §6, never operator-set.

conformance.description: #242 (increment C2 of #190 §6): the runtime conformance evaluator. Whether conformance is REQUIRED is derived from specs/<feature>/verification.yaml (any FR mapped to kind runtime_conformance) — an operator `required` key is rejected by name. The resolved contract (evaluator, app, interface, timeout_sec, criteria set) is frozen at preflight initialisation under the C1 pinning/tamper rules.

evaluator.description: providers.toml provider id. The provider MUST declare `conformance_command` — an evaluator-specific command template; declaring it IS the runtime_conformance capability. A healthy reviewer-only provider is refused: reviewer health proves liveness, not the ability to exercise a running application.

timeout_sec.description: Bounds the evaluator invocation. Frozen with the contract; explicit — no silent default.

app.description: Driver-owned app lifecycle: the driver, not the evaluator, starts and stops the application (own process group, TERM→KILL stop, output captured to the ledger). The evaluator-facing app interface is `interface` when present, else `ready.url`; command-only readiness with no `interface` is rejected by name — a capable evaluator must never be launched without an address for the app.

interface.description: Evaluator-facing address of the running application (e.g. its base URL). Resolved at freeze: `app.interface` else `ready.url`. Required when readiness is command-based.

ready.description: Readiness proof, bound to the launched instance: the probe MUST fail before launch (an already-answering responder is unattributable) and must succeed within timeout_sec with the spawned process group still alive. Exactly one of url | command.

coverage.description: Coverage floors. The FULLY RESOLVED contract (this block plus preset-derived values, plus the captured baseline) is frozen at preflight initialisation and is what every later gate reads — the live preset file is never re-resolved, including on resume.

artifact.description: Relative path inside the project. Containment is re-resolved with symlinks BEFORE deletion and again AFTER the command exits, since the driver deletes this path and the command is arbitrary project code.

parser.description: cobertura and jacoco are refused with 'not implemented in C1' rather than silently treated as passing.

baseline.description: none = greenfield: no artifact required at admission, absolute floor only. admission = brownfield: capture the base ref and enforce no-regression AND the floor.

max_regression_pct.description: Percentage POINTS, not relative. Required (effective, after preset resolution) for baseline 'admission'; rejected for 'none'. Governs exactly the metrics that have a configured floor.

preset.description: Names shared/templates/<preset>/verification-preset.json. Absent or unknown fails closed unless every required floor is supplied here.

timeout_sec.description: Bounds the arbitrary coverage command. Frozen with the contract; a host with no timeout mechanism refuses a coverage-enabled run on either profile rather than pretending to bound it.

allOf.description: At least one floor, or a preset that supplies one — a contract must commit to something.
max_regression_pct is meaningless with no baseline to regress from; accepting it there would be inert config.
FR-4 promises no-regression enforcement, so a brownfield contract needs an effective threshold: here, or from a preset resolved at preflight.

max_rounds.description: Rounds allowed PER ATTEMPT in the gating review loop (default 5). Read by the driver and passed to the runner; CCT_REVIEW_MAX_ROUNDS still overrides. The budget is per attempt so /review-decide retry can actually run another round — a cumulative ceiling made retry a no-op (#227).

loop_timeout_sec.description: Wall-clock budget for the WHOLE review loop across rounds (default 900). Restarts when a parked run resumes, so time spent waiting for a human is not counted against it (#205). Distinct from round_timeout_sec, and from the per-provider timeout_sec in providers.toml which bounds a SINGLE reviewer invocation.

estimate_usd_per_invocation.description: Conservative worst-case debit for an invocation whose real cost is unmeasurable. Debits the SAME caps.cost_usd (no separate allowance); flagged estimated:true in the ledger.

caps.description: Under profile: unattended, both caps MUST be explicit — no silent defaults (#190 §2: the published cost anchors run 5-8x the old default).
